title: Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) Devices for Obstructive Sleep Apnea

change_log.author: CarePolicyGuard Regulatory Informatics
change_log.summary: Statutory citation mapping against DME MAC LCD L33829.

description: Medicare local coverage determination for CPAP/APAP therapy in adult obstructive sleep apnea (OSA). Requires documented diagnostic polysomnography with AHI >= 15 events/hr or AHI 5-14 with documented comorbid hypertension, stroke, or excessive daytime sleepiness, and face-to-face clinical evaluation prior to sleep study.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Diagnostic Polysomnography (AHI/RDI)
criteria.description: Documented overnight diagnostic polysomnography demonstrating AHI or RDI >= 15 events/hr, or AHI 5-14 accompanied by documented comorbid symptoms (hypertension, excessive daytime sleepiness, stroke, ischemic heart disease).
criteria.clinical_intent: Confirm objective sleep apnea severity meeting statutory threshold
criteria.cms_document: CMS DME MAC LCD L33829 (Positive Airway Pressure Devices for OSA)
criteria.source_section: Coverage Indications, Limitations, and/or Medical Necessity - Initial Coverage
criteria.source_paragraph: Paragraph 1: AHI or RDI >= 15 events/hr, or AHI/RDI >= 5 and <= 14 with documented comorbid hypertension, stroke, or daytime sleepiness
criteria.source_text_excerpt: An initial positive airway pressure device is covered for beneficiaries with an AHI or RDI >= 15 events per hour, or an AHI or RDI >= 5 and <= 14 events per hour with documented symptoms of excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorders, or insomnia, or documented hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or history of stroke.

criteria.name: Face-to-Face Clinical Evaluation
criteria.description: Documented in-person face-to-face clinical evaluation by prescribing clinician prior to the diagnostic sleep study.
criteria.cms_document: CMS DME MAC LCD L33829 (Positive Airway Pressure Devices for OSA)
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Prior to the sleep test, the beneficiary must have a face-to-face clinical evaluation by the treating physician or practitioner to assess the patient for obstructive sleep apnea.
